scope: Curated exact Korean spellings and explicitly registered meanings. Explicit shortcut only; no fuzzy match or general translation.

phonePolicy.meaning: Numeric generation aliases, not full device names. Preserve compact spelling requested by the user.
phonePolicy.expansion: Explicit whitelist only. Next three annual numbers are reserved input aliases, not release announcements. Never extend using the clock.
phonePolicy.limits: Galaxy S generations only. iPhone 18 is a generation alias based on the announced Pro family. Original Galaxy S, iPhone 3G/3GS, X/XS/XR and SE are not fabricated as 1/3/9/10. No inferred Pro/Ultra/storage/carrier combinations.

nounPolicy.scope: Finite explicitly registered basic noun meanings and transparent compound labels. Exact explicit shortcut only; no contextual translation.
nounPolicy.people: Common family, relationship and occupation nouns are included. Proper person names and music groups remain excluded. Historical person-denoting restrictions below describe earlier batches only.
nounPolicy.ambiguity: Use directly reviewed everyday literal meanings. Owner-confirmed representative mappings override the targeted ambiguity holds for 선반=shelf, 세제=detergent and 장갑=gloves. Existing 배=pear, 사과=apple and 선물=gift are confirmed unchanged. The other 25 confirmed ambiguous spellings remain held. Rare homonyms or several source definitions sharing one English meaning are not automatically removed. This targeted decision does not claim a complete dictionary-wide ambiguity audit.
nounPolicy.authoring: English pairs authored and reviewed directly; Korean headword/POS/sense records from the existing NIKL Urimalsaem 2026-06-03 snapshot were checked separately. Original Korean definitions were read for targeted ambiguity and scope checks, not every definition for every row. English translations were not externally corroborated for every row. Per-row source status distinguishes noun evidence, compound expressions and directly authored labels. No source definitions, examples, corpus or media are shipped.
nounPolicy.sourceLicenseNotes: NIKL Urimalsaem metadata: CC BY-SA 2.0 KR, already attributed by the project. NIKL Korean learner vocabulary membership: KOGL Type 1. English pairs are directly authored; no dictionary definitions/examples are copied.

previousReviews.scope: Finite explicitly registered literal noun meanings, not a general translator. Existing owner-designated meanings are preserved.
previousReviews.people: No new person names, music groups or person-denoting noun meanings.
previousReviews.ambiguity: Exclude newly considered spellings with distinct ordinary meanings or person-denoting alternatives; equivalent synonyms alone are not different meanings.
previousReviews.authoring: Pairs authored directly, screened against the existing NIKL Urimalsaem 2026-06-03 noun/sense metadata, and reviewed pair by pair by the root. English source corroboration and selected definition checks are identified per row; not every definition was manually read. No definitions, examples or corpus are shipped.

ambiguityReview.criterion: Of the 28 targeted removals, the owner confirmed everyday representative meanings for 선반=shelf, 세제=detergent and 장갑=gloves. Those three are restored; the other 25 remain excluded. Existing owner-designated 배=pear, 사과=apple and 선물=gift stay unchanged. This is not a complete dictionary-wide sense audit.

ownerRepresentativeMeaningDecision.scope: Exact owner-confirmed representative meanings only. Other meaning candidates will be prepared by the owner. No new candidate-selection UI, contextual translation or extra semantic mappings are implemented.
